Jovanovic Model \`\`\`{julia} function jovanovic(Beta, mu, sigma0, sigma_mu) V0 = zeros(n) V1 = V0 k = V0 K0 = sigma0\^2 / (sigma0^2+sigma_mu^2) for t = 1:1000 print("Iteration number \$t") Q = exp_value(V0, grid, mu, sqrt(K0)*sigma_mu\^2) V0_a = zeros(n) theta_grid = LinRange(m_grid, -5*sqrt(K0)*sigma_mu, m_grid\[j\] + 5*sqrt(K0)\*sigma_mu, n) J = maximum(theta_grid./(1-Beta)repeat() aux = compute the whole value of the expected value
